name: ashaar-office
description: Microsoft Word task pane add-in for entering and justifying poetry with Ashaar.js.

scripts.start: office-addin-debugging start manifest.xml desktop --app word --dev-server "npm run dev-server" --dev-server-port 3000 --document test-documents/marsiya-test.docx
